In 2018, Ahmadi et al. [1] proposed a simple (1 + ϵ)-approximation distributed algorithm for the LP relaxation of minimum vertex cover and maximum weighted matching problems, which are special classes of 2-RS-FCPs and 2-CS-FPPs. They claimed the algorithm runs in O(log Γp /ϵ2 ) rounds, an O(Amax ) factor faster than our algorithm. Unfortunately, there is a flaw in their proof1 , and we do not know how to correct the proof to achieve the claimed bound. 2 Algorithms In this section, we present our algorithm (Algorithm 1) and the analysis. Indeed, our algorithm applies to general FCP/FPP instances, and we will prove the following theorem: ▶ Theorem 3.
